title: SearchGPT is a prototype of new AI search features
summary: We’re testing SearchGPT, a temporary prototype of new search features that give you fast and timely answers with clear and relevant sources.
body: We’re testing SearchGPT, a temporary prototype of new search features that give you fast and timely answers with clear and relevant sources.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了SearchGPT的初步测试版本，这是一个旨在提供快速、及时答案并带有清晰相关来源链接的新型AI搜索功能原型。该功能结合了对话式大模型的理解能力与网络搜索的实时性，为用户寻找信息提供了一种更直观的交互方式。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布了SearchGPT原型，标志着其正式切入AI搜索领域并带来全新交互体验。
